item.title: White House Aide Bets On Speeches
item.description:
White House Aide Bets On Speeches

The Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Friday ordered former White House teleprompter operator Gabriel Perez to pay $172,539 for using advance copies of President Trump’s speeches to bet on Kalshi “mention markets,” contracts that pay if the president utters specific words or phrases. The number is precise because the conduct was. Perez did not have an opinion about the news. He had the script.
